Here is a sample Semgrep rule for this vulnerability:

```yaml
id: vuln-countly-server-2bfa1ee1
title: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password
description: The application uses the SHA512 hash function to generate password recovery IDs, which is not secure.
severity: ERROR
languages:
  - javascript
metadata:
  CVE: CVE-2022-29174
  CWE: CWE-640
pattern: >
  {
    "match": "sha512Hash",
    "captures": {
      "argument_1": "$$anyArg$$",
      "argument_2": "$$anyArg$$"
    }
  }
```

This rule will match any usage of the `sha512Hash` function, which is a common way to generate password recovery IDs. The vulnerability here is that this method does not provide sufficient protection for user passwords and can be easily cracked by attackers.

The `captures` field allows you to specify specific arguments to match against. In this case, we're using `$$anyArg$$`, which matches any argument passed into the function. This rule will trigger a warning if such usage is found in your codebase.
